quest.title: The Warm Rhythm of the Streets
quest.description: To prepare supplies for your adventure, you and Paimon come to the Grand Bazaar...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nilou, it's nice to see you again!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: #Oh, hey there, {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you here for some shopping too?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: That's right. Although there were a few hiccups here and there, the Sabzeruz Festival turned out to be a grand success!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: And so, the theater wants to host a celebration event.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Do you two want to come? It'll be a really fun time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A celebration event?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: It's something like a tradition of ours. Whenever we wrap an important performance, we'll get together and unwind.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Rehearsals are exhausting... If you keep your nose to the grindstone, you're going to wipe yourself out sooner or later.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Mr. Zubayr, our manager, always says that celebrations aren't just for fun, but that they should also be occasions for reflection and review...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hehe, but no one remembers that once the celebration starts. It's not like he can't also have some fun himself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been to a lot of festivals during our adventures!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will your celebration also have lots of yummy food and drinks?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Of course! We always do lots of eating, toasting, and gift-exchanging. We try really hard to show our appreciation for everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, so we'll need to bring a present...

choices.text: Don't tell me you were planning to freeload?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way! Treat others how you want to be treated, right? Paimon already has a great gift in mind!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...But maybe you could lend Paimon some Mora first...?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Hahaha, it's fine! No need to stress, Paimon.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: You can come, present or not. The gift exchange is just to make the celebration more entertaining.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: You two being there would be the best gift of all! It'll also be a good time to introduce you to the rest of the theater.

choices.text: (Speaking of, since we last met her in her dream...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is something up?

choices.text: (Many more things have happened...)
Into a gift box you go, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Paimon's gonna put YOU in a box first!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A pity Dunyarzad can't also be here...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Yeah... but for now, it's more important for her to rest and recover.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: I tried to visit her, but I got turned away at the door... The people there wouldn't listen to a single word I said.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: All I could do was to leave a letter encouraging her to get some rest and keep her spirits up.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: She'll be better soon, and then we can celebrate together at the theater!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's all thanks to you and Nilou that we managed to save Dunyarzad!

choices.text: I just didn't want her to have any regrets.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: You're way too modest! Just now, I actually felt really self-conscious when Paimon talked about us in the same breath.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Compared to you, I really didn't do much at all.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Hehe, anyway, all that aside, are you thinking about coming to our event?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks it'll be a great time... What do you think, Traveler?

choices.text: Yeah, it sounds like fun.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Alright, then let's head to the theater...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: —Wait, I completely forgot about this pile of stuff!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Did you buy all of this, Nilou!?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Just one box. The rest were given to me. I really don't know how it came to this much...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's way too many freebies! Many vendors give out samples for free, but Paimon's never seen this much...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: All I know is that whenever I start chatting with people, my hands would get more and more full until I can't hold everything anymore. This seems to happen every time...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I was planning on making a few trips to bring everything back, before continuing on with my shopping... but I don't think I'll have the time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So this isn't even all of it!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let me help you.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: A—Are you sure?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Of course! Carrying stuff is a piece of cake for {M#him}{F#her}. Right, Traveler?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Ahh, I'm so sorry to trouble you like this... I meant to invite you to our celebration, but now, you're helping me instead...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Well, let's hurry up and grab the last few things, so we can get back to the theater.

choices.text: Sure, we have some time right now anyway.
She also helped us out a lot.

talks.objective: Collect the purchased goods with Nilou

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Oh, well if it isn't Nilou!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Greetings, Mr. Jut! Do you still have any food that's ready-to-go?

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Of course I do! I've heard that Zubayr Theater is hosting a celebration event, so I reserved some food for you in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Although, it looks like you're gonna need two more portions, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: #Ah, please allow me to introduce them! This is {NICKNAME}, a very experienced adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: #And this is Paimon, {M#his}{F#her} super reliable guide and helper.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Nonono, Paimon is—! ...Hold on, she got it completely right! Look, {NICKNAME}, she introduced Paimon correctly!

choices.text: Truly, a most rare occurrence.

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Hahaha, don't underestimate Nilou! She always remembers every last little detail about everyone, even if it sounds completely trivial.

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: She's also very brave. Just a little while ago, she saved my precious spices from the jaws of a Sumpter Beast!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Ahh, don't think anything of it! I just help out when I can because everyone else takes such good care of me.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Anyway, sorry to get off topic, we're in a bit of a hurry! Mr. Jut, did you say you didn't reserve enough food?

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Haha, I was joking! Anyone who runs a business knows to keep some extra stock. After all, orders get changed all the time.

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Oh, that reminds me, it seems that these friends of yours aren't from here. Have they ever tried any delicious Tahchin?

choices.text: What's that?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Ooh, what a fantastic idea! Mr. Jut, did you bake a batch recently?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Tahchin is a mixture of rice and meat that's baked into a cake-like shape. Mr. Jut adds special spices into his!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Its aroma is just so wonderfully delicious! If you ever see kids crowding all around Mr. Jut's place, you'd know he's baking up a storm.

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Hahaha, but is it really just for the kids? Don't you often follow them in, too?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I—I just can't help myself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're two peas in a pod! Who doesn't enjoy some good food?

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Wait here, I'll bring some over.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Everyone enjoys piping-hot Tahchin together.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Mmmmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, what a dish! It's sweet and sour and full of deliciousness! Paimon can't eat it fast enough!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Typical Paimon.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: No matter how many times I eat it, it's still so delicious!

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Haha, I wouldn't have offered it as a treat if I wasn't confident in the taste!

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: I baked a lot just now, and it's all packaged and ready for you to take back to the theater.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: You made so much! Is it really okay to take them all...

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: It was nothin'! Making one serving or one hundred servings is all the same to me. If anything, I should be thanking you for helping me clear my inventory.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We should pay you, at least.

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Don't worry about it! What kind of person would I be if I made you pay for a treat?

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Haha, make sure you got everything!

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Feel free to come back anytime.

choices.text: That sounds familiar...
She just introduced you as you are, Paimon.

talks.objective: Collect another batch of goods with Nilou

dialogues.speaker: Afshin
dialogues.text: Nilou, good timing! I have the textiles you ordered.

dialogues.speaker: Afshin
dialogues.text: If you took any longer, the Sumpter Beasts might've gobbled them up.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: You and your jokes! Sumpter Beasts won't eat those kinds of things, Mr. Afshin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jut said that some Sumpter Beasts ate his spices. Were they yours?

dialogues.speaker: Afshin
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, haha... Yeah, really sorry about that. Nilou, if it weren't for you, I would've lost half of my profits that month.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Trying to pull anything out of a Sumpter Beast's mouth is like playing a game of tug-of-war...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So they really do eat anything, huh.

choices.text: At least they work after eating.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? What's that supposed to mean!

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Hahaha, come now. You know, Sumpter Beasts sometimes eat not because they're hungry, but because they like gnawing on things.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: The textiles you ordered are highly durable and woven from the finest thread.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: So, even if a Sumpter Beast got snacky, it'd still have to chomp on it for a full day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...You've tested this before?

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: But of course! How else could I be so trustworthy? ...Well, that one time was an accident.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: I wouldn't dare experiment with such a precious product.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True, it does sound like some good fabric...

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Oho, have I piqued your interest? If you want to buy some, now's a good time: Buy two bolts and get 20% off!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ooh, that's a pretty good discount. What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: No thanks, Mr. Afshin. You can't use that kind of tactic on her. Look, you've already sucked her in.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Tactic? So you mean, everything he just said to Paimon was a lie?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Ah, I wouldn't go that far... It's just that Mr. Afshin is really good at spinning stories. A word from him, and you'll find yourself buying things you don't actually need.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Mr. Zubayr gave me a huge lecture the last time I bought too many things...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Vendors shouldn't use manipulative tactics.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: C'mon, don't look at me like that... All she got was a talking-to from Zubayr, while I was nearly fed head-first to the Sumpter Beasts.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: My philosophy is that stories give value to merchandise. That's why my business started with such a boom.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Our Nilou here is an extraordinarily good listener. Back then, she believed anything I said.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: After a while, I began to feel guilty selling things to her because of how happy she looked... Though she enjoyed the stories and I the Mora, I knew she didn't need to buy that much...

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Anyway, since then, I've come to realize two things: One, that stories should just be a means instead of an end, and two, that there's more to business than just selling goods.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: It's okay, we're all friends now. There's no need to dig up the past.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Hmm, that reminds me... Some of the goods from my latest shipment aren't in the best condition.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: They're fine for general use, but my customers have high standards, and I don't have the time or resources to find new buyers right now.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Nilou, why don't you take them?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Huh? No no no no, I can't do that...

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Just think of it as a favor for me, alright? The theater can use them for props and whatnot.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: It costs me Mora to store or ship, so I'm just losing money every day continuing to hold on to them.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Even so, let me buy them at market value.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Nah, these goods are hard movers. Besides, if I let you pay, wouldn't it mean that I'm just using stories to sell my goods again?

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Just take them. If you really feel that bad about it, give me some theater tickets later.

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Oh yeah, you should also take some while you're at it. Adventurers are always in need of materials, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, even we get a share of this...?

response.speaker: Afshin
response.text: Hurry and take it. Just looking at it all is giving me a headache. Haha, thanks for the huge favor.

choices.text: The one thing that Paimon has in common with Sumpter Beasts.

talks.objective: Collect the last goods with Nilou

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: About time, Nilou! Farhad here was snooping around your props!

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Please, I was only looking at them to get a better idea of what your new show may be about.

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Wouldn't spoiling yourself just ruin all the fun?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Yeah, please wait for our official performance!

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Hmm, these two look familiar. I think I've seen them before...

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Weren't they at the Sabzeruz Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Yeah, and they're coming to today's celebration, too.

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: The more folks the merrier! I was actually just talking to Farhad about also stopping by tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Oh yes, please do! I'm sure Ms. Rekhar and Miss Najia would also love to have a chat with the two of you.

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: We even prepared a small gift — let me show it to you. Ta-da, it's a flower wreath!

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: I really think we should wear some of these to give the event a more celebratory feel.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Wow, it's beautiful! Did you make it?

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Farhad did most of the work. What a surprise, eh? He actually knows a lot about crafts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That is pretty surprising...

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Hey, why can't I have a little side hobby? I worked really hard on that!

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: I know, I know, I watched you make it. I wasn't making fun of you.

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Alright, why don't you also try some on? We've got some wreaths in your size.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: It fits perfectly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're so pretty! Is there one that Paimon can wear?

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, we already gave out all the child-sized ones. I wasn't expecting the theater to invite such a fascinating guest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Fascinating"...? That sounds kinda weird, but Paimon will let it slide.

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Oh, you all sure got a lot of stuff there. Let me help you carry some.

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: I'm a porter by trade, so this is what I'm best at.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That'd be great! Please and thank you!

choices.text: Weren't you going to help out?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we have a pro now...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Thanks for the help, Mr. Farhad, but let me make one thing clear first: Don't try to ask about what's in the new show.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Otherwise, I may not be able to hold back Mr. Zubayr this time.

response.speaker: Hushang
response.text: Hahaha, you're so obvious that even Nilou saw right through you!

response.speaker: Farhad
response.text: Shut it!

response.speaker: Farhad
response.text: Fine! It's not like I want to get on his bad side, either.

response.speaker: Farhad
response.text: Including Hushang's things, though, we'll each need to carry a box if we want to move everything in one trip. Even my strength has its limits.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Paimon looks like she doesn't want to, so I'll carry a little extra. Hehe, although I may not appear super strong at first glance, I actually do a lot of strength training on the regular.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Strength and balance are both really important for a dancer!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, let Paimon! Paimon will help carry things!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Traveler's right. Paimon shouldn't freeload...

choices.text: After all the free food and materials...

talks.objective: Go back to the theater with Nilou

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Phew, that sure was a lot of stuff. Looking forward to the event later!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Thank you, Mr. Farhad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you, Sumpter Man...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Paimon's definitely going to eat it all back later!

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll leave you all to it.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: See ya.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Good thing we had Mr. Farhad with us, or else that would've taken way longer.

choices.text: The atmosphere here is so nice...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Of course, because everyone's working here together.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: We're all like neighbors, so we're always helping each other out. It's easy to forget that everyone's running a business.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: With this many freebies being thrown at you, you probably don't need to work...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Hehe, I felt so guilty at first, like I always owed someone something. I was always thinking of ways to repay others.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Later on, I realized that it's actually like what Mr. Afshin said — by taking the freebies, I was helping everyone out and saving them money.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: When you order the wrong item or make too much of something, sometimes the best way to maximize the value of those goods is to give them away.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: That's why there's no need to stress over the freebies. All of us repay others by helping them when they need it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that actually makes a lot of sense!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: This has become our norm, and no one keeps track of the back and forth anymore.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: So really, don't worry about it.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Alright, I have to bring all of this to Mr. Zubayr and do a little bit of prep.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Feel free to hang out here for a bit. It'd be nice if you could also get to know some other people at the theater!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You sure you don't need any help?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Nope. Mr. Zubayr's really on top of everything.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: You two are our guests, so please just relax and look forward to the celebration.

choices.text: Is everyone always this friendly?

talks.objective: Talk to the members of the theater

dialogues.speaker: Rekhar
dialogues.text: Hey there. I saw you two helping Nilou move some stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Rekhar
dialogues.text: Are you two also here for the celebration event?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You got it!

dialogues.speaker: Rekhar
dialogues.text: My name is Rekhar. Najia and I are this theater's prop engineers. I also help out with some other tasks, like housekeeping.

dialogues.speaker: Rekhar
dialogues.text: The little ones causing a ruckus are my children, Sohrin and Abhi. I hope they aren't bothering you.

dialogues.speaker: Rekhar
dialogues.text: They always get really excited every time we hold a celebration event.

choices.text: They're adorable.

response.speaker: Rekhar
response.text: Yes, they are. Everyone here takes great care of them.

response.speaker: Rekhar
response.text: There's good work here, the pay's always on time, and Nilou and the others will often volunteer to play with the kids...

response.speaker: Rekhar
response.text: I'm quite content with this current way of life.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, do you mean your life wasn't nearly as good before?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon...

response.speaker: Rekhar
response.text: It's alright, it's all water under the bridge now.

response.speaker: Rekhar
response.text: My husband and I were both adventurers, but he passed away from an accident.

response.speaker: Rekhar
response.text: Material struggles can always be overcome, but ever since then, I haven't been able to spend much of my energy on anything else...

response.speaker: Rekhar
response.text: But I still consider myself lucky. Mr. Zubayr has helped me a lot, and the atmosphere here is tolerant and kind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sorry for bringing up such sad memories...

response.speaker: Rekhar
response.text: Oh, it's alright, I don't mind.

response.speaker: Rekhar
response.text: Once the event starts, you'll be able to see for yourself the kind of atmosphere I was talking about.

choices.text: They're so lively.

talks.objective: Talk to the members of the theater

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there!

dialogues.speaker: Khasani
dialogues.text: Hm... Ah, a newcomer.

dialogues.speaker: Khasani
dialogues.text: Doesn't look too bright.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Talk about judging a book by its cover!

dialogues.speaker: Khasani
dialogues.text: You, on the other hand... Hmm, you're a special one.

dialogues.speaker: Khasani
dialogues.text: How would you describe the concept of "art"?

choices.text: "Art"?

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: Mere curiosity, is all. It makes no difference whether you answer or not.

choices.text: It is a tangible manifestation of human sentiments?

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: So that's what you think, huh...

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: Unremarkable. Better than an average person's thoughts, but nothing exceptional.

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: Is art a product that we create and bring forth, or is it a naturally existing resource?

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: I, for one, believe it to be the latter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, Paimon doesn't follow...

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: I've been staying here for a long time. On occasion, I'd assist them in penning lines of dialogue, but most of my time, I just stand back and watch.

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: I prefer to abstain from writing, as it spoils the viewing experience.

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: The existence of the theater, of Nilou, and of humanity itself... All of these can be considered as forms of art. It is not some intangible construct beyond the horizon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How does that have anything to do with us?

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: Let me ask you this: What do you think is the meaning of art?

choices.text: I dunno.

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: Haha, I suppose that question was a little too difficult for you.

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: To chance upon a spark of inspiration, I have been closely observing you, the players on the stage, and those watching in the audience.

response.speaker: Khasani
response.text: Art is already all around us.

choices.text: To serve as an answer to your questions?
It is an expression of our aesthetic ideals?
Why are you asking that all of a sudden?

talks.objective: Talk to the members of the theater

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello!

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: Wh—Wha!?

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: Who are you? You can't just go on the stage as you please.

choices.text: Relax.

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: Ah, I see... Sorry for my overreaction.

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: I'm just, uh... making a prop. No time for chit-chat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that embroidery?

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: No... Well, yes, but not really. It's a prop.

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: It's just, uhh, some fabric. An ordinary piece of fabric that will be used in a show.

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: Sorry, I really do need to focus and start working on it.

choices.text: Sorry to bother you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What an oddball. Is prop-making something to be that jumpy about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh well, it's none of our business.

choices.text: We won't disturb you, then.
We're here with Nilou.

dialogues.speaker: Rekhar
dialogues.text: There's still some time until the event. Feel free to look around.

talks.objective: Talk with Nilou and wait for the event to begin

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Sorry for the wait! Preparations for the celebration are finally done.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: I'll call everyone over, and then we can start.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let us give you a hand!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Everyone gathers together, and the event finally starts. Participants prepare to exchange their presents.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe we really should have prepared a gift. Then we could also be a part of the exchange!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As it is, all we can do is wait and watch...

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: Umm... Maybe we shouldn't do this after all?

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: I didn't do that great of a job, and who would even like it?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Don't think like that! Remember our promise? We're going to give everyone a pleasant surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: And besides, you've never attended a celebration event before, so this will be a great opportunity. Everyone will love you!

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: I'm still... not really sure about this...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: There's nothing to be worried about! Just take a step forward, and give yourself a chance.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: There aren't any scary people here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: Right...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hmm, alright, maybe this will help.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Everyone, over here! Inayah has something great to tell you all!

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: W—Wait, wait!

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: I've already said that I'm not ready yet... Agh, what should I say...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Take it easy and relax. Deep breath, in and out. Once you've taken a long exhale, calmly tell everyone what you want to say.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: If you don't say anything, then all the hard work we've put into embroidery practice would have gone to waste.

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: Using it as a gift, though? It really isn't that good...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So when Inayah was talking about making a prop, she was actually preparing a present.

choices.text: She looks really nervous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, it feels like she still doesn't really see herself as part of this community.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it looks like Nilou's trying to ease her through.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Actually, Inayah had prepared a special present for everyone before this celebration kicked off.

response.speaker: Sohrin
response.text: Woohoo!

response.speaker: Abhi
response.text: We're gonna get our first present from Miss Inayah!

response.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
response.text: Pipe down. The louder you all are, the more nervous she'll become.

response.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
response.text: You've worked on it for so long, so have some confidence. Don't be afraid.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've got this!

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: Is Mr. Zubayr here?

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: Sheikh Zubayr, this is an urgent notice from the Akademiya. This celebration — or whatever it is — must stop at once.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a condescending guy... What's his deal?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Everyone follows Sheikh Zubayr to the space below the theater.

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: Since Zubayr Theater has long violated the Akademiya's policies and orders, we have decided to demolish it.

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: As its manager, you must halt all operations and dismiss all staff members within thirty days, after which you will report to the Akademiya for further punishment.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Why...? Why force us to do this all of a sudden?

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: Little girl, this is not the first time you've been issued a warning.

response.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
response.text: I didn't hear anything about demolition the last time I asked, and now I suddenly only have thirty days?

response.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
response.text: We have more shows planned, but it's impossible to do anything in just thirty days. How am I supposed to explain this to my customers and staff?

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: That issue is of no concern to me, Mr. Zubayr.

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: You seem to understand the situation quite clearly. Perhaps you can reflect on the reasons why you have failed to prepare for the scenario in advance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Demolition? Why do they wanna demolish this place?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: The Akademiya has never liked us, and they've never respected our work. To them, what we do is all a waste of time.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: This isn't the first time they've come by. They had asked us several times in the past to improve the quality of our performances by only putting on shows they consider to be sufficiently intellectual.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: But our audience isn't the Akademiya — it's the people of the Grand Bazaar.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: If our shows are too difficult to understand or too removed from everyday life, nobody would watch them anymore...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Changing our content would not only mean turning our backs on our vision, it would also directly lead to the loss of our livelihoods.

choices.text: If the theater actually gets demolished...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Yeah... The theater is very important to each and every one of us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The way they're doing things is so scummy!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: But... I also don't know how we can stop them.

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: I do not wish to explain everything again from the beginning. Time is of the essence, so you should act with haste instead of asking frivolous questions.

response.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
response.text: But none of us plan to accept this. Such an abrupt notice is contrary to established policy.

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: Ask whomever you will — the answer will remain the same. We have already given you sufficient notice.

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: Enough.

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: Does your audacity know no limits, Father!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Father? They're family!?

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: What Akademiya? This is all because you don't like Zubayr Theater. You're just using the Akademiya's name to threaten us!

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: Let me tell you: Even if you manage to tear down this place, nothing is going to change.

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: You've always been awful, but even I never thought my father would sink this low!

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: This is strictly business. It has nothing to do with where you are, what you do...

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: ...Or what you think.

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: I hope you all have not been irrevocably blinded by folly. I will not waste more time on pointless arguments.

response.speaker: Sharif
response.text: Wrap everything up and make preparations to shut down at once.

response.speaker: Inayah
response.text: Why is he always like that!?

response.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
response.text: This is quite the misfortune, but there's nothing we can do.

response.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
response.text: That's it for today, everyone. Let's clean up.

response.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
response.text: I'll go talk to them again tomorrow. *sigh* The storms that come out of the blue are always the hardest to deal with.

choices.text: Many people would become displaced.
She's not very good at expressing herself.

talks.objective: Talk with Nilou about the current situation

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who cares, let's just take them in a fight!

choices.text: That won't solve the underlying problem.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I'll try to think of something. We can't just let everyone suffer in a perpetual state of fear and uncertainty.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: What to do, what to do...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can you pretend to shut down, but secretly continue to hold your shows somewhere else?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or we could go through a list of customers, and try to see if anyone in there might be willing to help out... Ugh, that also doesn't sound like it'll work.

choices.text: I think a scholar once told me that...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: A debate? Hmm... Well, scholars do love to use them to solve their problems, but... how would that work in this case?

choices.text: We just need to prove...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, if we can prove to Inayah's father that the Akademiya's position doesn't hold water, then they won't have a reason to demolish the theater!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I see. Defeating him in a debate...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: It's a good idea, but which one of us could hope to win against a researcher...?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Huh? Me?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Nonono, I'm the literal worst at arguments.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I can't debate...

choices.text: Debates aren't arguments.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nilou, you are only so stressed out right now because you care so much about protecting the theater!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: This theater holds a special meaning in all of our hearts — it's irreplaceable.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: But I just don't know... Can I really take on such a huge responsibility?

choices.text: You'll be fine as long as you prepare.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon will help, too! You'll feel a lot more confident after doing some prep work. Believe in yourself!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Thanks, you two.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Alright, I've decided!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Even though I may fail, I'll do my very best for everyone's sake!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's our Nilou! We're rooting for you!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Okay, let's head back and tell everyone what we came up with.

choices.text: I'll do my best to help.
You debate to prove that you are right.
That the theater's existence has value.
Differences can be settled through a debate.
We won't always be here.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Haha, off with ya. Don't think Sohrin and Abhi will be able to hold out for much longer for that Tahchin...

dialogues.speaker: Afshin
dialogues.text: Thanks for the huge favor. *sigh* The most important thing about doing business is efficiently circulating merchandise...

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: I still have some stuff to sort through. Catch you later.

dialogues.speaker: Khasani
dialogues.text: Unparalleled splendor without peer...

dialogues.speaker: Khasani
dialogues.text: Maybe even worthy of being considered one of Sumeru's greatest treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: Sorry, I need to focus.

dialogues.speaker: Sohrin
dialogues.text: I just saw Miss Nilou come back with Tahchin! There's gonna be Tahchin!

dialogues.speaker: Abhi
dialogues.text: Are you sure?

dialogues.speaker: Sohrin
dialogues.text: Duh! And even if I didn't see it, I smelled it! It's gotta be Tahchin!

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Prop check complete. All that's left is to discuss some dates with Rekhar...

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, Farhad is coming... Maybe I should hide the key props...

dialogues.speaker: Kourosh
dialogues.text: It's finally over! I'm saved!

dialogues.speaker: Kourosh
dialogues.text: Oh, sorry, I was just letting off some steam because I'm so relieved... Please don't tell Mr. Zubayr.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Hmph, they get more and more unreasonable with each passing day.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: I have to think of something...

dialogues.speaker: Sohrin
dialogues.text: Is this place gonna get torn down?

dialogues.speaker: Abhi
dialogues.text: Nooo, I don't want that to happen...

dialogues.speaker: Rekhar
dialogues.text: Shh, don't cry... That man was just trying to scare us.

dialogues.speaker: Kourosh
dialogues.text: Why couldn't he just have a good faith discussion with us? There's always room for compromise.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Well, if there really was, then we wouldn't be in this predicament.

dialogues.speaker: Khasani
dialogues.text: The carefree warmth of summer will always give way to the bleak futility of winter.

dialogues.speaker: Khasani
dialogues.text: Man is even more fickle than the seasons.

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: Sorry, my father is always like that.

dialogues.speaker: Inayah
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Sorry, I invited you thinking this was going to be a happy occasion. I didn't know that things would turn out like this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's no need to apologize, Nilou! No one could've seen this coming. *sigh* Paimon just wishes she could've at least gotten to the food...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is what that guy said true? The Akademiya has already given you many warnings?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Yeah, I guess you could say that. They've always seen us as being meaningless.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Knowledge is king in Sumeru, and their pursuit of it leaves no room for the arts.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: But if that's all it is, there's also no reason to go so far as to demolish the theater.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So it really has something to do with Inayah.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: After Inayah ran away from home, I brought her here, to Zubayr Theater.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: She rarely talks about her family. All I know is that she didn't get along with them.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: I never expected it to blow up like this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you did nothing wrong, then there's no reason to listen to the Akademiya, right?

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: This just came out of nowhere. What'll happen next?

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Beats me. Everyone else must also be at a loss.

dialogues.speaker: Zubayr Theater Billboard
dialogues.text: Due to special circumstances, all theatrical performances have been cancelled and the resumption time has yet to be determined. Sorry about the inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you run into any trouble after your dance?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: You mean when I danced at the square right in front of the Akademiya? Hehe, not a single person came after me. I left really easily.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: After that, no one came to the theater to scold me, either. We actually gained many new customers... And, they were all Akademiya students.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: From what I can tell, in the past, if a student were to put off their studies to watch a show or dance, they'd be called foolish and irresponsible.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: But now, it seems like this attitude is changing. People are starting to believe that engaging with the arts can help them balance their moods, and through that, improve their research efficiency at work.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Anyway, it seems like people have to personally experience something to gain a good understanding of it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They should thank us for opening their eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hopefully, they'll appreciate the arts more.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: That'll probably take some time... They're still droning on and on about "experimentation" and "proof." Will they really gain more appreciation for the arts if they continue to think of everything like that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can ask Nahida to lend a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Nahida... Ah!? You mean, Lesser Lord Kusanali!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She'd probably help if she knew what was going on. No matter how nasty the Akademiya could get, surely they can't win against Lesser Lord Kusanali!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Nononono, I wasn't doubting her ability... I just feel like we shouldn't bother her with such a trivial problem.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Plus, if the Dendro Archon were to intervene... Then, it wouldn't feel like our victory was earned.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's true...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Paimon's starting to understand how you got so many things.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Y—Yeah... Everyone has their own way with words, and it's really hard to say no...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Let's go to the next store.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *pant* *pant*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't fly anymore...!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Are you okay, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's good to keep going! But Paimon now understands when people say there's no such thing as a free lunch!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, the atmosphere here is so nice...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's take a break, and immerse ourselves in this warmth!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, Nilou's back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's meet up with her. The event's probably about to start!
